label: ACTUAL_PUBLIC_HISTORY_AND_HYPOTHETICAL_SIZE_NOT_MARKET_PERFORMANCE
limitations: Diagnostic acquisition does not supply independently reviewed quote liquidity or listing identity.
No automatic qualification, settings increases, repairs, account mutations or backtest calls.
Current public metadata is not authenticated historical constraints; configured costs are estimates.
Real spot supports 1x only here; max 3x is a ceiling, not a product capability.
Size-only arithmetic omits current account/day/position/halts and cannot grant risk approval.

markets.symbol_bound_by: exact query pair and current active discovery; no per-row symbol or historical listing proof

theoretical_minimum.note: Arithmetic lower bound only, not a new configuration or permission; excludes margin-plus-fee cash and other gate checks.

assumptions.rate_basis: user-configurable fraction of filled notional on EACH entry and exit
assumptions.fill_basis: adverse fractional price adjustment on EACH entry and exit
assumptions.spread: not separately modeled; no historical bid/ask evidence
assumptions.funding: not modeled; no supported funding data or derivatives contract
assumptions.other_costs: tax, borrow, liquidation and exchange size rules not modeled
assumptions.leverage: abstract collateral simulation, not a verified CoinDCX margin product
